# Presidio To Acquire Producing Permian Oil and Gas Companies for $360 Million


November 18, 2026 7:38am EST


*Expected to Increase 2027 Production by 50% and Operating Cash Flow by More than 60%*


*Third Acquisition in 2026 Establishes Presidio’s Expansion into the Permian Basin, Demonstrates Growth Strategy Execution*


FORT WORTH, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Presidio Production Company](https://bypresidio.com/) (NYSE: FTW) (“Presidio” or the “Company”) today announced the execution of definitive agreements to acquire RRP Acquisitions 1 LLC and RRP Operating LLC from an affiliate of Rushmore Resource Partners LLC, a portfolio company of Trace Capital Management LP, for $360 million (the “Acquisition” or the “Transaction”), subject to customary closing adjustments. The acquired entities own and operate developed, producing oil and gas assets of Rushmore Resource Partners in the Southern Midland region of the Permian Basin.


The Acquisition is expected to increase Presidio’s net production by approximately 50% and net cash provided by operating activities by more than 60%. The acquired assets are expected to begin contributing to Presidio’s reported financial results upon closing, anticipated in the first quarter of 2027.


The acquired companies predominantly hold operated, mature proved developed producing (“PDP”) assets, with production of approximately 12.8 MBoe/d, made up of 15% oil, 39% NGLs and 46% natural gas. The Acquisition contains assets with an estimated year-one decline rate of 8%, similar to Presidio’s existing portfolio of stable oil and gas wells.


The Acquisition marks Presidio’s third acquisition in 2026, establishes its first position in the Permian Basin and is consistent with Presidio’s acquisition criteria: operated, low-decline, stacked-pay upside potential, with opportunities for operational optimization and AI implementation. In addition, Presidio expects significant additional acquisition opportunities within the Southern Midland Basin, following its land-and-expand strategy.


**Transaction Rationale**


- **Demonstrates Presidio’s Growth Strategy:** Third acquisition in 2026 and a new operated platform in the Permian Basin, applying the same land-and-expand approach Presidio has used in the Western Anadarko Basin.
- **Strong Return on Equity, Accretive to Cash Flow per Share, Longevity to Dividends:** Expected to generate attractive returns on equity capital invested, to be accretive to cash flow per share, and is expected to provide longer-term dividend support.
- **Operated, Low-Decline PDP Assets:** 358 active operated wells with long production histories in the Spraberry and Wolfcamp formations and gathering, water handling and takeaway infrastructure already in place, consistent with Presidio’s focus on stable, producing wells.
- **Permian Position with Stacked Pay:** A liquids-rich position in the Permian Basin, the largest oil-producing basin in the United States, with stacked pay potential across the Wolfcamp benches. Presidio intends to develop this upside through carried-interest joint development ventures, as it has done across its existing portfolio.
- **Optimization and AI Implementation:** Presidio will assume operatorship at closing and deploy its engineers, field team and Mainspring, Presidio subsidiary FTW Technologies’ proprietary AI oil and gas operating system.


**Acquisition Highlights**


- Third acquisition of 2026 represents strategic entry into the Permian Basin for $360 million
- Estimated PDP PV-10 of approximately $426 Million
- Net production of approximately 12.8 MBoe/d (15% oil, 39% NGLs and 46% natural gas) from 358 active operated wells with a year-one decline of 8%
- Expected to increase Presidio’s 2027 production by approximately 50% and operating cash flow by more than 60%
- Expected to be accretive to net income per share, cash flow yield and cash flow per share
- Asset cash flows combined with optimization and AI implementation expected to produce greater than 20% annualized returns on equity capital invested
- More than 60,000 acres of undeveloped stacked pay potential in the Wolfcamp


**Commenting on the Acquisition**


“This is our third acquisition in 2026, our largest to date, and marks Presidio’s entry into the Permian Basin. It is exactly the kind of opportunity we built Presidio to pursue,” said Will Ulrich, Chairman and Co-CEO. “These mature, low-decline, producing assets fit our acquisition criteria, and the size of this transaction makes it a transformative step for the Company. In one transaction we expect to grow production by approximately 50%. We believe the transaction cash flow will not only enhance our dividend in the near term but will also sustain it in the longer term. Beyond this acquisition, we see substantial opportunities in our pipeline ahead which we believe can further deliver attractive returns and grow dividends over time.”


“This acquisition gives us a substantial operated position in the Southern Midland Basin within the broader Permian resource play,” said Chris Hammack, Co-CEO and Director. “These wells have long production histories and established infrastructure, and we see opportunities to improve their performance through our operating approach. We will be ready on day one to assume operations and put our engineers, field team and Mainspring, our proprietary AI system, to work reducing costs, limiting downtime and improving well performance. We also believe this position can serve as a platform for further growth in the area, following the same land-and-expand approach we have used previously.”


**Transaction Financing and Hedging**


- Presidio expects to fund the Transaction using the $1.0 billion warehouse facility with Goldman Sachs and Citizens Bank, N.A., the $60 million revolving credit facility, and available cash. The Transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions.
- Presidio anticipates adding hedges with respect to the Acquisition, in addition to its current hedges.


**Advisors**


Truist Securities served as financial advisor and Sidley Austin LLP served as legal counsel to Presidio. Goldman Sachs and Citizens Bank, N.A. served as lenders and structuring advisors for the Presidio ABS Warehouse Facility.


Houlihan Lokey served as financial advisor and Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher LLP served as legal counsel to Rushmore Resource Partners LLC.


**About Presidio Production Company**


Headquartered in Fort Worth, TX, Presidio Production Company (NYSE: FTW) is a yield-focused, differentiated oil and gas operator in the United States focused on the acquisition and optimization of producing oil and natural gas wells, without drilling. Presidio applies engineering expertise and AI-driven analytics to enhance performance and extend asset life. The Company’s Class A common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “FTW”. To learn more, visit[https://bypresidio.com/](https://bypresidio.com/) .


**Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


Operating cash flow refers to net cash provided by operating activities, a measure calculated in accordance with GAAP; the estimated increase presented in this release is derived from the Company’s acquisition model. Accretion to net income per share, cash flow per share and cash flow yield, returns on equity capital invested and operating cost reductions attributable to the acquired assets are management estimates derived from the Company’s acquisition model and are not historical results of the Company. PV-10 is the estimated present value of future net revenues from estimated proved developed producing reserves, discounted at an annual rate of 10%, is not calculated in accordance with GAAP, and is not intended to represent the current market value of estimated reserves. PV-10 presented in this release reflects NYMEX strip pricing as of September 22, 2026 through 2029, held flat thereafter. Because the Transaction has not yet closed, a reconciliation of these estimates to the most directly comparable GAAP measures is not available without unreasonable effort.
